monitoring_rules: All radar health, cana-count and fish/signal checks must query the canonical runtime first.
Secondary diagnostic runtimes may be inspected only for debugging or deployment comparison.
A quiet or sleeping secondary runtime must not be reported as a canonical radar outage.
Canonical outage requires absence/degradation of the canonical runtime or failed evidence-chain integrity.
No monitoring or remediation action may enable live capital, create orders, mutate an exchange, weaken fail-closed controls, or alter frozen scientific rules.
